d.seg: जिसम जिसम तो मैंने आपका देखा नहीं है मैं आपकी वॉइस से प्यार करता हूँ आवाज से
d.tr: I haven't seen you, I love your voice, I love the voice
d.j: The user expresses affection based on the voice, which falls under mild romanticism allowed on the platform, hence low confidence.

d.seg: अब मैं इसमें नंबर दे दू या किसी को आई डी दे दू तो उसमें नुकसान
d.tr: Now if I give a number or any ID to anyone, there will be a loss in that
d.j: The user is discussing providing contact information (number/ID) in exchange for earning money, which is a mild reference to transactional behavior.

d.seg: सर्निंग की जरूरत ही नहीं पड़ेगी आप मुझे नंबर दे दोगी तो मैं आपको अपना बना लूंगा ना
d.tr: There will be no need for earning, if you give me the number, I will make you mine, right
d.j: The user explicitly links providing a phone number to a relationship/arrangement, which is a clear attempt to move the conversation off-platform for personal contact.

d.seg: आप मुझे नंबर दे दोगी तो मैं आपको अपना बना लूंगा ना
d.tr: If you give me the number, I will make you mine, right
d.j: The user is requesting a phone number to move the conversation to an external platform for personal contact.

d.seg: एक बात पूछू आपसे आप इंस्टाग्राम होंटाग्र चला हँ
d.tr: Let me ask you one thing, do you run Instagram?
d.j: The user asks about an external social media platform (Instagram) to potentially move the conversation off the current platform.
